name: leaf-gbc1-model-lunar-leaf-5day-simulation
title: LEAF GBC1 'Model Lunar LEAF' 5-Day Spaceflight Simulation Dataset
description: Comprehensive 5-day (120-hour) computational multi-physics dataset for the LEAF GBC1 spaceflight plant growth chamber. Encompasses subsurface water activation in porous foam, Nytex mesh root exclusion, push vs pull aerodynamic CFD, developmental ontogeny, mixed-convection gravity (0g-1g), temperature sweeps (18-30 C), and optical lid condensation defense.

resources.name: 5day_hourly_telemetry
resources.description: Hourly 120-hour multi-species state matrix covering canopy height, leaf area, drag factor, CO2 exchange, transpiration, and condensation margin.

resources.name: push_vs_pull_aerodynamics
resources.description: Comparative aerodynamic metrics across 10 pump speeds for Push (positive gauge) vs Pull (suction negative gauge) flow regimes.

resources.name: gravity_temp_response_surface
resources.description: Full factorial response surface spanning 4 gravity levels (0g, 0.166g, 0.38g, 1.0g), 5 air temperatures (18-30 C), and 5 ventilation rates.

resources.name: water_activation_foam_nytex
resources.description: Vertical moisture saturation profiles in the 7.0 mm porous foam cassette and Nytex mesh Young-Laplace bubble point curve.

resources.name: gbc1_gci_mesh_convergence
resources.description: ASME V&V 20-2009 standard 3-grid convergence index verification study across 1.50, 1.00, and 0.75 mm pitches.

resources.name: gbc1_foliar_surface_distribution
resources.description: Canopy microclimate percentiles (p10, p50, p90), spatial CoV, and dynamic range across flight regimes.

resources.name: gbc1_164plants_foliar_telemetry
resources.description: Individual scalar microenvironment telemetry for all 164 plants (32 B. rapa + 100 Arabidopsis + 32 B. rapa).

resources.name: gbc1_spaceflight_hardware_comprehensive_benchmark
resources.description: Multi-system spaceflight hardware comparative benchmark across NASA BRIC, CARA, VEGGIE, and LEAF GBC1.
